title: Equivariant Stolz R-group invariance under a 2-connected G-map in dimensions at least six
source_version: Official SIGMA 21 (2025) journal PDF and native TeX; acquired 2026-09-30; exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: Surjectivity and injectivity require arranging equivariant Morse handles on bordisms with corners, separating low-dimensional extension obstructions from codimension-at-least-three metric surgery, and preserving vertical boundary data. The relative factorization and surgery constructions are retained; a formal homotopy-invariance assertion would omit the core.
author: Massimiliano Puglisi; Thomas Schick; Vito Felice Zenobi
